if: the document is a credit note or a debit note referred to in section 34
it is issued under rule 53(1A) of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the credit or debit note MUST carry the serial number(s) and date(s) of every tax invoice or bill of supply it adjusts
note: One mandatory particular of rule 53(1A)(g), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: serial number(s) and date(s) of the corresponding tax invoice(s) or, as the case may be, bill(s) of supply;
evidence.extraction_note: Rule 53(1A)(g) is PLURAL where rule 53(1)(h) is singular: one credit or debit note may adjust more than one invoice.
